mentions.claim_text: He says he sees a disturbance trying to break out into war in that area, and China provoking alongside North Korea.
mentions.quote: There's a disturbance trying to break out war there
mentions.falsify_match: Armed conflict breaking out in the region named.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The location is given only as there, so it cannot be pinned.

mentions.claim_text: He says China is trying to rise like a great red dragon coming up out of a volcano, that there will be movement in the days ahead, and states explicitly that he is not saying when because he does not see it.
mentions.quote: I'm not saying when. I'm not seeing that
mentions.falsify_match: A major Chinese move on the world stage.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. To his credit he states outright that he has no timing, which is a hedge he does not always give.

mentions.claim_text: He says Kim Jong-un is being promised a lot which makes him confident, that there are secret meetings, and that North Korea, China and Russia are becoming one, with Iran alongside.
mentions.quote: North Korea and China and Russia becoming one
mentions.falsify_match: A formal three or four-way bloc between those states.
mentions.falsify_miss: None forms. Note the Beijing military parade of 3 September 2025, twelve days earlier, put Xi, Putin and Kim on the same platform, which is the public event this describes.

mentions.claim_text: He says outcast countries are in view, that there are minerals of value in Afghanistan, and that South Korea and Taiwan are American allies which China wants.
mentions.quote: There's something in Afghanistan that is minerals
mentions.falsify_match: Afghan mineral wealth becoming a strategic issue.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. Afghanistan's lithium and rare earth deposits have been publicly valued at around a trillion dollars since a 2010 US survey.

mentions.claim_text: He describes communism imposed over South Korea causing war, an explosion on the border, South Korea unable to hold, and China backing North Korea.
mentions.quote: I saw a explosion on the border
mentions.falsify_match: War on the Korean peninsula with Chinese backing for the North.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Undated, but the border explosion and the Chinese role are specific.

mentions.claim_text: He describes land grabs shaping a new world order, with Russia wanting the old Soviet territory including Ukraine and Poland and calling for a stronger new Soviet Union.
mentions.quote: Russia wanting the old Soviet Union, Ukraine, Poland
mentions.falsify_match: Russia moving to reconstitute the Soviet borders including Poland.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. Poland was never a Soviet republic, only a Warsaw Pact state, which is a factual slip in the framing.

mentions.claim_text: He says Cuba is lining up with Russia and that a base that close to America would be very dangerous, comparing it to the position with Greenland.
mentions.falsify_match: A Russian military base established in Cuba.
mentions.falsify_miss: None established. A named country and a named facility type, which makes it checkable.

mentions.claim_text: He says the horse is riding quickly and the green or pale horse and the black horse will ride hand in hand so that famine and pestilence go together, repeats war three times, and says he sees Hawaii and that everything is going to change.
mentions.quote: famine and pestilence will go hand in hand together
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither. The imagery is Revelation 6 rather than a new word.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees a massive volcano going off in Asia, possibly Japan or those islands, and hesitates over the identification.
mentions.quote: It looks like it could be Japan. It's those islands
mentions.falsify_match: A major volcanic eruption in Japan or the nearby island arc.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He hedges the location, and Japan has about 111 active volcanoes, so the region is close to the most likely place on earth for one.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is looking at Canada, that it went from Canada into the royals with England where he saw King Charles, and that it barely influenced Australia.
mentions.quote: it went from Canada all the way into the royals with England
mentions.falsify_match: A Commonwealth realignment running through Canada, the British crown and Australia.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. No act is attached to any of the three.

mentions.claim_text: He says everything has accelerated in the month, that America stood in a vote as the Lord said it would, and that a Jonathan and David relationship would begin even more in the days ahead.
mentions.quote: a Jonathan and a David relationship would begin even more
mentions.falsify_match: A close alliance forming as described.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He is reading a UN vote as the fulfilment rather than forecasting.

mentions.claim_text: He says the enemy is trying to come into America to wreak havoc as a great distraction and to start great turbulence and civil unrest.
mentions.quote: for a great distraction, for a great turbulence to begin, civil unrest
mentions.falsify_match: Widespread civil unrest in America used to mask something else.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Undated and without a threshold.

mentions.claim_text: He says he was shown a well-thought-out plan against five major cities, naming Chicago, Philadelphia, Washington DC, New York and Boston, and says the Lord will not allow him to go into the depth of it right now.
mentions.quote: He showed me Chicago, Philadelphia, Washington DC, New York, and Boston
mentions.falsify_match: A coordinated attack plan against those five cities.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Five named cities is unusually specific; the withheld depth is the part that cannot be checked.

mentions.claim_text: He says a shaking to awaken is coming for the body of Christ, that there is a window to bring in the lost as quickly as possible, and that this is one last call, with angels heard from west to east.
mentions.quote: this is a one last call, for a great shaking is coming
mentions.falsify_match: A shaking identifiable as the one described.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Last call has been said repeatedly across the corpus since 2023.

mentions.claim_text: He describes clouds vibrating as they said whoa over America and the ground shaking from west to east, and says he saw a great earthquake in California and a great volcano getting ready to go off.
mentions.quote: I saw a great great earthquake taking place in California
mentions.falsify_match: A major California earthquake and a volcanic eruption.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither. Undated, and California quakes are claimed repeatedly across the corpus.

mentions.claim_text: Mid-stream his family reports a magnitude 7.4 earthquake off Russia at 9:30 that evening, and he says the Lord had told them they would see it.
mentions.falsify_match: USGS records a magnitude 7.4 near Russia on 13 September 2025. A magnitude 7.4 did strike off Kamchatka that day.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such quake. Note it is read off the news during the stream, after the event, and Kamchatka had been in an aftershock sequence since the magnitude 8.8 of 29 July 2025.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer that trafficked children across Europe and out of Ukraine be found and called home, and against those who abuse them.
mentions.quote: ALL THE ONES THAT ARE BEING TRAFFICKED OUT OF UKRAINE

mentions.claim_text: Prompted by a family member with a reference, he prays Hosea 2:6 over the children, that they be hedged with thorns and not touched by an unclean hand.
mentions.quote: they'll not be touched by an unclean hand
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a scripture prayed over the trafficked children.
